svg.title: Yohans Seife: the AI stack, built bottom-up
svg.desc: Animated neural network whose inputs are Ge'ez glyphs and whose outputs are token IDs. Zero engine dependencies and 73.5 percent fewer tokens than GPT-4 on a Ge'ez test set.
svg.text: AUTOGRAD / VECTOR STORE / BPE / TRANSFORMER / INFERENCE SERVER
